Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a final standalone transparent PNG collectible personal achievement pin for ClanSync. Use the supplied concept sheet only as design reference. Match its polished champagne-gold raised metal partitions and outlines, emerald/jade and mint with warm ivory hard-enamel inlays, friendly fantasy collectible craft, restrained material highlights. One isolated pin, straight-on front view, centered on a square 1024x1024 canvas, whole silhouette clearly inside the middle 76% with at least 12% genuinely transparent alpha padding on each side. This is stage 3 of four growth stages. Avoid the winged phoenix above it; no bird or wings. Preserve the curving elegant broad flame silhouette and open contours. Omit all surrounding sheet elements and the label 09.
